sentences.text: On 1.31, add the fields to the `spec.versions[*].selectableFields` field of the CustomResourceDefinition to declare them as selectable with field selectors.

citations.quote: The `spec.versions[*].selectableFields` field of a CustomResourceDefinition may be used to declare which other fields in a custom resource may be used in field selectors

gaps: The 1.27 documentation excerpts do not cover this.
